refers.refers_to: Ravensgar Hall, the hall Lord Edmund claims by right

groups.reason: Snippets [1]-[3] name the hall Ravenscar Hall, [4] has Edmund Thorn coming home to Ravenscourt Hall, and [5] has Lord Edmund claiming Ravensgar Hall by right while [3] labels the same episode's library as Ravenscar Hall, showing these are spelling variants of one estate.
